metadata.title: The Cargo Ship That Sailed Into a Hurricane
metadata.description:
El Faro sank in Hurricane Joaquin. The cause: flooding through an open scuttle, loss of propulsion, and progressive flooding in heavy seas.

Failure chain: Route kept near the storm → Outdated weather data → Ship lists, water enters → Propulsion lost → Ship sinks

Related episode: Inside SS Arctic: The Failure Chain — https://youtu.be/zq07sKTZmCs

Series — Maritime Disasters: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOjaDNq7OIVc
